name: splunkready
description: Splunk-native certification harness for AI agents before they touch production Splunk.

scripts.check: npm run verify:scaffold && npm run verify:runtime-contracts && npm run build && npm run ui:build && npm run audit:public-demo-export && npm run audit:package-readiness && npm run audit:package-installability && npm test && npm run audit:secret-env-ignore && npm run audit:reviewers && npm run audit:submission-copy && git diff --check
scripts.judge-proof: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js judge-proof --out artifacts/judge-proof --json
scripts.judge-proof:llm: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js judge-proof --out artifacts/judge-proof --include-llm-proof true --json
scripts.llm-proof: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js llm-proof --out artifacts/llm-proof --require-pass true --json
scripts.mcp-proof: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js mcp-proof --out artifacts/mcp-proof --json
scripts.workbench: npm run build && npm run ui:build && node dist/src/workbench/server.js
scripts.public-demo:build: npm run build && npm run ui:build && node scripts/export-public-demo.js
scripts.public-demo:deploy:netlify: npm run public-demo:build && npx netlify deploy --dir=artifacts/public-demo
